blurb: Guests enjoy a 90-minute floating tiki boat tour around Bristol Harbor on a 28' pontoon boat with a tiki bar and sound system. The boat is equipped with seating, a bar, Bluetooth stereo, and a cooler with ice. Tours are BYOB and family-friendly, with alcohol consumption restricted to guests 21 and older.
extraNote: No bathroom on board; can return to dock if needed but reduces tour time · Reschedule or refund if weather conditions are unsafe (rain, wind, poor sea state) · Boat slip at the Bristol Town Dock, 127 Thames St. Bristol RI USA
